youtube.title: Why USB Plugs Have Little Square Holes 🔌 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
The small square holes on the metal shell of a USB-A plug are there for grip. Inside the USB port are tiny metal spring tabs, and when you push the plug in they click into those holes. That holds the plug firmly in place so it doesn't slide out when the cable is bumped or tugged, while still letting you pull it out on purpose. The click you feel is the springs locking in.
